literal_meaning: আল্লাহর মহিমা (শাব্দিক: সুবহান = মহিমা/পবিত্রতা, আল্লাহ = ঈশ্বর)
figurative_meaning_en: Astonishing or expressing wonder at something extraordinary
example_sentences_in_bangla: সুবহানাল্লাহ, এই দৃশ্য দেখে মন ভরে গেল!
example_sentences_in_english: Subhanallah, this sight fills the heart with awe!
Subhanallah, what an extraordinary feat they have accomplished!
history: Derived from the Arabic phrase 'Subḥāna -llāhi', meaning 'Glory be to God', originating from Islamic texts like the Quran and Hadith, used by Muslims worldwide to express amazement at divine creation.
note: Commonly used in Bengali Muslim communities; spelling variations reflect regional pronunciations.
